ane-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：昂热马塞机场（ANE）位于绿色植被与农田之中。
ane-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Angers Marcé airport (ANE) lies among green vegetation and farmland.

ane-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 阴云下，灰白色的航站楼横展开来，玻璃幕墙上橙色字标出机场名称，门前场地空无一人。
ane-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under heavy cloud, the low grey terminal stretches wide, its name in orange letters above the glazing, with an empty forecourt in front.

ane-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 夕阳中一架涡桨客机停在航站楼前，塔台与写着昂热-马塞的矮楼在旁，地勤人员站在机下。
ane-chatgpt-02.webp.en: In low evening sun, a turboprop airliner rests before the terminal, with the control tower and a low building lettered Angers-Marce alongside and ground staff nearby.

ane-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 航拍昂热机场：成排的灰色机库沿机坪排开，塔台立在中间，停机坪上散落着几架小型飞机。
ane-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An aerial view shows ranks of grey hangars along the apron, a control tower in the middle and several light aircraft parked on the concrete.

ane-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 飞行模拟软件截图：编号26的跑道笔直伸向远方，中线与接地区标志清晰，两侧是草地和树林。
ane-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A flight-simulation screenshot shows runway 26 running straight into the distance, its centreline and touchdown markings sharp between grass and woodland.

ane-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 阴沉的天空下，一架白色小飞机停在草地边，身旁的红色标牌标出26-08的方向与位置。
ane-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Beneath a flat grey sky, a small white light aircraft rests on the grass beside a red sign marking 26-08.

ane-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 航站区入口的白墙上，橙色飞机图案与昂热卢瓦尔机场字样并排，下方注明马塞市镇范围。
ane-chatgpt-06.webp.en: On a white wall at the airport entrance, an orange aircraft graphic sits beside the words Angers Loire Aéroport, with the commune of Marcé noted below.

ane-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 晴朗天空下，一架白绿相间的轻型飞机停在机坪黄色引导线旁，身后是一排深灰色机库。
ane-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A white and green light aircraft is parked beside yellow taxi lines on the apron, with a row of dark hangars behind it under a clear sky.
